ctx.x: See, but what happened was that when they Hitler party began to rear its head and old man von Hindenburg was becoming old and incompetent, see, of handling the government, you see, Hitler was not in power, but he was practically, in the he was making the power. Well, the first thing, they didn't want any American music -- the Nazi Party, they didn't want any American music, and especially the ragtime or jazz played by blacks. They didn't honor blacks at all. So, they refused, they barred the contract, they…
So that was in late '31 or early '32.
